title: Influencing hair regrowth with EGCG by targeting glycogen synthase kinase-3beta activity: a molecular dynamics study.
authors: Moqaddasi, Hamid Raza; Singh, Anshul; Mukherjee, Shoma; Rezai, Fatima; Gupta, Arti; Srivastava, Saurabh; Sridhar, Sathvik Belagodu; Ahmad, Irfan; Dwivedi, Vivek Dhar; Kumar, Sandeep
journal: Journal of receptor and signal transduction research
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接和动力学模拟评估EGCG对GSK3beta的抑制作用以促进毛发生长，对象为蛋白-小分子互作，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA体系无关。
abstract: Hair follicle growth process through several well-organized stages with specific input by several signaling pathways including Wnt/beta-catenin and Sonic Hedgehog with GSK3beta in this process. As such, this research focus on investigating the efficacy of molecules that are able to inhibit GSK3beta action in inducing hair regrowth. Applying computational techniques, three compounds NMN, Resveratrol and EGCG were analyzed for their GSK3beta inhibition. It was established that EGCG has the highest values of molecular docking scores and, in the case of the stability criteria such as RMSD and RMSF, presented the most stable dynamic simulation. EGCG has shown considerable TEMPORAL STABILITY with GSK3beta in the complex, because over a period of 200 nanoseconds the molecules remained bound through hydrogen bonds and hydrophobic contacts. As confirmed by PCA, the largest conformational changes in GSK3beta suggest significant inhibitory interaction. Out of all the studied compounds, EGCG turns out to be the most potent GSK3beta inhibitor for hair regrowth purposes. The result obtained from the molecular dynamics simulation indicates that EGCG might exert a favorable impact to extract signaling pathways related with hair follicle cycling which is a significant objective. These outcome sets the phase for further experimental testing to discover the potential of EGCG in the treatment of alopecia.
abstract_zh: 毛囊生长过程经历多个组织良好的阶段，并受到包括Wnt/β-catenin和Sonic Hedgehog在内的多种信号通路以及GSK3beta在此过程中的特定输入调控。因此，本研究聚焦于评估能够抑制GSK3beta作用的分子在诱导毛发再生方面的效力。通过应用计算技术，分析了三种化合物NMN、白藜芦醇（Resveratrol）和EGCG对GSK3beta的抑制作用。结果表明，EGCG具有最高的分子对接得分值，并且在稳定性标准如RMSD和RMSF方面，表现出最稳定的动态模拟。EGCG在与GSK3beta的复合物中显示出显著的时域稳定性（TEMPORAL STABILITY），因为在200纳秒的时间段内，分子通过氢键和疏水接触保持结合。通过主成分分析（PCA）确认，GSK3beta中最大的构象变化表明存在显著的抑制性相互作用。在所有研究的化合物中，EGCG被证明是用于毛发再生的最有效GSK3beta抑制剂。分子动力学模拟的结果表明，EGCG可能对提取与毛囊周期相关的信号通路产生有利影响，这是一个重要目标。这些结果为进一步的实验测试奠定了基础，以探索EGCG在治疗脱发（alopecia）中的潜力。
